original_final_diagnosis: Perineal scar endometriosis (会阴切口子宫内膜异位症)
misdiagnosed_condition: Unknown
key_clinical_findings: 会阴侧切处进行性肿胀、疼痛，确诊为子宫内膜异位症，需手术挖除

original_final_diagnosis: Cauda Equina Injury (医源性马尾损伤), Neurogenic Bladder (神经源性膀胱), Neurogenic Bowel (神经源性直肠)
misdiagnosed_condition: Cauda equina injury (漏诊/未及时识别马尾神经损伤)
key_clinical_findings: Postoperative inability to urinate/defecate after catheter removal; imaging: L1-2 intraspinal lipoma; surgical findings: iatrogenic cauda equina injury

original_final_diagnosis: Kidney Calculi (双肾多发性结石) with hydronephrosis, urinary tract infection, renal insufficiency, thrombocytopenia, cardiac insufficiency
misdiagnosed_condition: Unknown
key_clinical_findings: Gross hematuria, bilateral kidney stones, hydronephrosis, urinary tract infection, renal insufficiency, thrombocytopenia, cardiac insufficiency

original_final_diagnosis: Nonunion of Fracture, Internal Fixation Failure (骨折不愈合，内固定失效)
misdiagnosed_condition: Failure to recognize poor reduction, intra-articular screw placement, and premature hardware removal leading to nonunion
key_clinical_findings: Postoperative imaging showed poor fracture reduction, screws in joint space, and nonunion; subsequent hardware removal before healing led to loosening and displacement.

original_final_diagnosis: Primary liver cancer (原发性肝癌) with multiple metastases, acute upper gastrointestinal hemorrhage, hemorrhagic shock, acute hemorrhagic anemia, left lower limb open fracture with crush injury (left thigh amputation), right ankle avulsion injury, traumatic shock, sepsis, acute respiratory failure, stress ulcer, gastric ulcer
misdiagnosed_condition: Primary liver cancer (原发性肝癌) (missed/delayed diagnosis)
key_clinical_findings: CT revealed liver space-occupying lesion (not communicated to patient or consulted); progressive enlargement on follow-up CT; upper gastrointestinal hemorrhage; multiple metastases

original_final_diagnosis: Pulmonary Embolism (急性肺栓塞), Deep Vein Thrombosis (深静脉血栓形成)
misdiagnosed_condition: Postoperative deep vein thrombosis and pulmonary embolism (漏诊/未有效防范)
key_clinical_findings: Bilateral great saphenous vein varicosities with superficial thrombosis; postoperative left calf deep vein mixed thrombus with detachment; acute pulmonary trunk and bilateral pulmonary artery embolism

original_final_diagnosis: Chronic osteomyelitis of calcaneus (慢性骨髓炎), calcaneal defect (跟骨缺损), sinus tract (窦道)
misdiagnosed_condition: Failure to diagnose and manage wound healing issues leading to chronic osteomyelitis
key_clinical_findings: Non-healing wound after hardware removal, sinus tract, calcaneal defect on imaging

original_final_diagnosis: Lumbar Spinal Stenosis, Intervertebral Disc Displacement, Intradural Extramedullary Tumor (疑似神经鞘瘤)
misdiagnosed_condition: Intradural Extramedullary Tumor (硬膜囊内占位病变)
key_clinical_findings: Left lower limb pain and numbness for 6 months; postoperative persistent pain and inability to walk upright; missed intradural lesion on preoperative imaging

original_final_diagnosis: Postpartum Sheehan's Syndrome, Uterine Rupture, Hemorrhagic Shock
misdiagnosed_condition: Uterine rupture (incomplete rupture of lower uterine segment) and refractory postpartum hemorrhage
key_clinical_findings: Severe postpartum hemorrhage after delivery; suspected lower uterine segment defect on vaginal exam and ultrasound; delayed laparotomy (5 hours); hemorrhagic shock, DIC, multi-organ failure; subsequent diagnosis of Sheehan's syndrome with adrenal and thyroid insufficiency.

original_final_diagnosis: Multiple uterine fibroids (多发性子宫肌瘤), iatrogenic left ureteral injury (医源性左侧输尿管损伤), left ureterovaginal fistula (左输尿管阴道瘘), left ureteral obstruction with hydronephrosis (左侧输尿管下端梗阻性改变伴左侧肾盂肾脏及全段输尿管扩张积水)
misdiagnosed_condition: Postoperative complications (ureteral injury, fistula) were missed; no imaging performed after surgery
key_clinical_findings: Left ureteral injury during total abdominal hysterectomy, left ureterovaginal fistula, left hydronephrosis and hydroureter

original_final_diagnosis: Acute epiglottitis (急性会厌炎) with hemorrhagic necrosis and abscess formation, acute laryngeal obstruction, acute interstitial pneumonia, acute bronchitis, acute pulmonary congestion, pulmonary edema, bronchospasm
misdiagnosed_condition: Acute laryngopharyngitis (急性咽喉炎)
key_clinical_findings: Dyspnea, high fever (39.5°C), inability to speak, respiratory distress, eventual respiratory and circulatory failure

original_final_diagnosis: Kidney Failure, Chronic (慢性肾衰竭尿毒症期); Cholecystitis (结石性胆囊炎)
misdiagnosed_condition: Chronic renal failure uremia stage (diagnosis based on insufficient evidence, inaccurate assessment of hemodialysis duration)
key_clinical_findings: Fatigue, poor appetite, facial edema, stomach pain; hemodialysis initiated; arteriovenous fistula surgery performed; postoperative mild dialysis access-related ischemic syndrome

original_final_diagnosis: Old fracture of left tibial plateau, Old fracture of left ankle with subluxation and joint stiffness, Post-traumatic osteoarthritis of left knee, Deep vein thrombosis of lower extremity
differential_diagnoses: Acute fracture of left tibial plateau
misdiagnosed_condition: Left ankle fracture (lateral malleolus/posterior malleolus), left tibial plateau fracture, severe ligament rupture
key_clinical_findings: Swelling and pain of left knee and ankle after trauma; X-ray only of left knee initially; later imaging revealed old fractures, subluxation, joint stiffness, and DVT

original_final_diagnosis: Meningoencephalitis, Acute Heart Failure, Coronary Artery Disease, Paroxysmal Atrial Fibrillation, Hypertension (Grade 3, Very High Risk), Pneumonia, Renal Insufficiency, Secondary Thrombocytopenia
misdiagnosed_condition: Cerebral infarction (initially diagnosed, but actual condition was meningoencephalitis)
key_clinical_findings: Recurrent chest tightness for 5 years, acute worsening for 2 weeks, altered consciousness on Feb 11, abnormal lung exam (discrepant documentation), lack of timely specialist consultation and inadequate anti-infection treatment

original_final_diagnosis: Peptic Ulcer Perforation with Peritonitis, Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus with Ketoacidosis, Multiple Organ Failure, Dilated Cardiomyopathy
misdiagnosed_condition: Peptic Ulcer Perforation, Diabetic Ketoacidosis
key_clinical_findings: Persistent right lower quadrant pain, hyperglycemia, chest tightness, shortness of breath, cardiac arrest

original_final_diagnosis: Severe Myocarditis (重症心肌炎); Acute Heart Failure (急性心力衰竭); Cardiogenic Shock (心源性休克)
misdiagnosed_condition: Severe myocarditis early symptoms misdiagnosed as common cold; initially diagnosed as acute myocardial infarction and upper respiratory tract infection at hospital
key_clinical_findings: Progressive worsening after cold treatment, generalized weakness, anorexia, mild dry throat, stomach fullness

original_final_diagnosis: Neonatal respiratory distress syndrome (hyaline membrane disease), neonatal shock with persistent pulmonary hypertension, perinatal massive pulmonary hemorrhage, neonatal heart failure and respiratory failure
misdiagnosed_condition: Delayed diagnosis of neonatal respiratory distress syndrome and its complications
key_clinical_findings: Cyanosis, intermittent moaning, frothy sputum, respiratory distress, low birth weight, prematurity

original_final_diagnosis: Hyperkalemia (高钾血症)
misdiagnosed_condition: Water-electrolyte imbalance (水电解质紊乱) with risk of severe electrolyte disturbance; missed hyperkalemia risk
key_clinical_findings: Serum potassium 6.6 mmol/L; cardiac arrest; subsequent hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy, left cerebellar hemorrhage, cerebellar tonsillar herniation, multiple organ failure

original_final_diagnosis: Vitreous Hemorrhage (vitreous hemorrhage)
misdiagnosed_condition: Endophthalmitis (not suspected despite signs of inflammation and vitreous hemorrhage)
key_clinical_findings: Left eye not red; inflammation and signs of vitreous hemorrhage; a few white cells; no hypopyon; no retinal tear; retina attached

original_final_diagnosis: Cellulitis, Sepsis, Shock, Septic, Multiple Organ Failure
misdiagnosed_condition: Lower limb soft tissue infection, Erysipelas (initially misdiagnosed as acute cellulitis was missed)
key_clinical_findings: Right lower leg abscess, postoperative systemic severe infection, septic shock, multiple organ failure

original_final_diagnosis: Left Shoulder Dislocation, Left Humeral Shaft Fracture
misdiagnosed_condition: Left shoulder dislocation (initial diagnosis, but fracture was missed or caused iatrogenically)
key_clinical_findings: Left shoulder pain after fall; iatrogenic left humeral shaft fracture during closed reduction without anesthesia

original_final_diagnosis: Sudden Cardiac Death, Pneumonia, COVID-19, Severe Hypertension, Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus, Acute Coronary Syndrome
misdiagnosed_condition: Pneumonia (missed Acute Coronary Syndrome)
key_clinical_findings: ECG highly suspicious for Acute Coronary Syndrome; fever; chest pain; chest tightness; fatigue

original_final_diagnosis: Schizophrenia, Miliary Tuberculosis with Caseous Pneumonia, Severe Long-term Malnutrition, Acute Respiratory Failure
misdiagnosed_condition: Miliary tuberculosis with caseous pneumonia (missed due to lack of routine labs and chest X-ray; edema not investigated)
key_clinical_findings: Bilateral lower extremity and facial pitting edema; autopsy showed miliary tuberculosis, caseous pneumonia, severe malnutrition (scaphoid abdomen, thin chest/abdominal wall fat)

original_final_diagnosis: Myocardial Infarction (急性心肌梗死) - extensive anterior wall myocardial infarction (广泛前壁心肌梗死), inferior wall myocardial infarction (下壁心肌梗死)
misdiagnosed_condition: Initially misdiagnosed as chronic gastritis and enteritis (慢性胃炎肠炎); acute myocardial infarction was ruled out before deterioration
key_clinical_findings: persistent chest and abdominal pain with history of hypertension and cerebral infarction; rising cardiac injury markers (心肌损伤检查结果数值递增); possible occult cardiovascular disease

original_final_diagnosis: Hypoparathyroidism, Post-procedural Hypocalcemia, Thyroid Carcinoma
differential_diagnoses: 原发性甲状旁腺功能减退
低钙血症其他原因（如肾功能不全、维生素D缺乏）
misdiagnosed_condition: 医源性甲状旁腺功能损伤（单侧误切）
key_clinical_findings: 术后血清总钙及甲状旁腺素（PTH）进行性降低（最低3.16pg/mL），空腹血钙1.93mmol/L，确诊为永久性甲状旁腺功能低下
